Wal-mart, shopping, and eateries are just minutes away  We offer full sewer hookups,  30 and 50 amp electric sites, the NEW Met WI-FI internet, trash, and water.  For your convenience an air-conditioned coin-op laundry, green areas, and a well groomed park is provided.
Our RV park caters to the short and long term occupants, with nightly, weekly and monthly rates.  Our cabins are super nice and are fully furnished and all bills pd.  We cater to traveling medical personnel and clients who are working in the area.  We offer reasonably priced monthly stays in Cabins with no lease required.  Clients prefer our park over local hotels.
